props.name: accessibilitySummary
props.description: High-level summary for assistive technologies (Apple Audio Graphs pattern).

props.name: mark
props.description: Chart mark type — bar, line, or point.

props.name: onPointFocus
props.type: (point: ChartDataPoint, seriesId: string, index: number) => void

props.name: showPoints
props.description: Combine line marks with point marks. Default true for line charts.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Stack bar marks when multiple series are present.

props.name: stackGap
props.description: Gap between stacked bar segments (Apple HIG visual separation).

props.name: yAxisTrailing
props.description: Y axis on trailing edge (right in LTR) for layout alignment.
